title: Kid Rena's band and Maurice French
summary: He recalls clarinettist Maurice French in Kid Rena's band, now in Laplace, and sitting in for Joe Rena.

I know these guys have been so long and I know who they work with, but as the years go by you forget. Like in Kid René's band, Zip, a fine clarinet player. You ever hear of Maurice French? Why don't you fellas go pick up Maurice French? You know where a lot of Maurice French was at? I was at his home about three weeks ago. I played out in a high school out there and I talked to Maurice French. He's in Laplace. He's in a Resort, they go to Laplace. I got it from Albert. You got it from Albert?
I could run up there with Punch sometime. I wonder if he ever worked with Punch. That would be fun.
He'd go up there and Morris would give you the whole lowdown on this time. That's right.
Did you play with him in the old days?
I played with Kid Rene's band. He was playing Rene's band at the time. Joe Rene's playing. I used to play sometimes. Joe couldn't play and I played sometimes.
